mapper.insert: insert into TAX_VAT_SCHEDULE select _NEXTINDEX('TAX_SEQUENCE') AS SEQ_NO, /*流水号*/ #{schId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS SCH_ID, /*方案代码*/ ASSET_CLASSIFY, /*资产分类*/ CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE, /*本金收益特征*/ INCOME_TYPE, /*收入类型*/ TAXABLE_SIGN, /*计税方式*/ TAX_RATE, /*应税税率*/ FEE_TYPE, /*免税收入类型*/ EFF_DATE, /*生效日*/ CREATE_USER, /*创建人*/ CREATE_DEPT, /*创建部门*/ CREATE_TIME, /*创建时间*/ UPDATE_USER, /*更新人*/ UPDATE_TIME /*更新时间*/ from TAX_VAT_SCHEDULE where SCH_ID = #{refSchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
